items.headline: Circle Launches Arc L1, Mints 10B $ARC With Visa Onboard
items.summary: Circle's new Layer 1 Arc is live with BlackRock, Visa and DTCC among 11 validators, and 10B $ARC were minted at genesis. Public token launch still undecided.

items.headline: $ZEC Defies Fed Hike, Rockets to $1,383
items.summary: $ZEC ripped to $1,383 even as the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 whipsawed $BTC. Privacy coins are stealing the spotlight this week.

items.headline: World Money Super App Launches With Stripe, $WLD Rewards
items.summary: World's new self-custody super app plugs into Stripe, Kalshi and Morpho, with World ID unlocking boosted rewards. A big DeFi-onboarding play for $WLD.

items.headline: MEV Bot Front-Runs $7.8M $RSETH Exploit on Ethereum
items.summary: An MEV bot called Yoink beat the original attacker into the same block, sweeping 2,882 $RSETH worth ~$7.8M. Part rescue, part heist.

items.headline: US $HYPE Perps? Kraken Parent Plans Permissioned Markets
items.summary: Kraken parent Bitnomial plans permissioned Hyperliquid perps for US traders, with NinjaTrader Clearing carrying accounts. A new regulated lane for $HYPE.
